notes: PLAYED vs NEXT, unmistakable. Practice guidance now clearly separates the CURRENT note from the UPCOMING one everywhere: on screen the target wears the solid accent ring while the next note gets a dashed, gently pulsing ring; on your MIDI keyboard the current key is lit solid and the NEXT key BLINKS — solid-vs-blinking reads on every keybed, including the LUMI (whose own lighting normalizes brightness, which is why the old bright/dim pair looked identical). Applies to both the auto practice runner and Guide mode on the Keys page.
